tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Returns the authenticated AlpineLead account's credit balance and usage limits.

tools.name: get_credit_packs
tools.description: Returns the available AlpineLead agent credit packages.

tools.name: create_credit_checkout
tools.description: Creates a Stripe checkout link for purchasing AlpineLead agent credits. Payment requires human confirmation.

tools.name: discover_leads
tools.description: Use for exploratory DACH prospecting when the user wants a company list before deep analysis. If the user wants only qualified, scored opportunities, prefer find_opportunities.

tools.name: analyze_company
tools.description: Use when a specific company and website are known. Returns explainable FIT / NEED / NOW opportunity intelligence and saves the analysis as an AGENT / API history source.

tools.name: generate_sales_kit
tools.description: Use after a prospect has been analyzed and is worth contacting. Generates structured, outreach-ready sales context.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Use this first when you need to understand AlpineLead OI tools, costs, DACH focus, workflows or which capability is available.

tools.name: recommend_next_tool
tools.description: Use when the user's intent is understandable but you are unsure which AlpineLead OI tool should be called next.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Use when the user wants qualified opportunities, not a raw company list. This tool discovers candidates, analyzes FIT/NEED/NOW, applies personal Learning Engine and Winning Pattern/Anti-ICP filtering, and returns only accepted opportunities.

tools.name: radar_check
tools.description: Use only for an existing/known lead when the user asks what changed, whether commercial signals appeared, or whether Opportunity Delta increased or decreased.

tools.name: winning_pattern
tools.description: Use when the user asks what kinds of prospects historically win or lose. Returns learned Winning Pattern and Anti-ICP signals from closed leads.

tools.name: learning_engine
tools.description: Use when the user asks how AlpineLead OI has adapted FIT / NEED / NOW scoring to their actual wins and losses. Returns personal weighting and learning confidence.

tools.name: hunter_configure
tools.description: Use when the user wants AlpineLead OI to keep looking for new opportunities over time. Creates, updates, enables or pauses the Autonomous Hunter sight field.

tools.name: hunter_run
tools.description: Use after Hunter is configured when the user wants a fresh autonomous prospecting run now. Returns only accepted opportunities plus usage information.

tools.name: set_estimated_value
tools.description: Sets or overrides the estimated EUR pipeline value of an existing lead.
